findings.text: contract.yaml and README claim refusal records are pinned to the 'exact contextual identity,' but the refusal_id hash (Go and Python) only incorporates contextual_identity.request_id and base_hash, dropping the schema-required subject_identity field and the optional work_graph_hash/environment_pins

README claims schema_validation_test.go 'Validates JSON outputs against draft 2020-12 schemas,' but the included test only performs a Marshal/Unmarshal round-trip check — it never loads or validates against any .schema.json file. The claim is unearned.

evaluator_refusal_record.schema.json declares node_kind as a closed enum (check/graph/review/acceptance), but neither the Go nor Python model validation enforces it, unlike reason_code — an inconsistency between the declared schema contract and the executable model.
